 Open Navigation Menu Menu Beauty 8 Thai Beauty Brands to Shop on Your Next Trip to Thailand
 Your next under–the–radar beauty find could be in Thailand By Sanika Achrekar October 26, 2026 Sirilak Kwong. Photo: @linglingkwong If your beauty shelf is looking increasingly Seoul–inspired, it might be time to make room for Bangkok. Thailand may be known for its herbal balms, but there’s plenty more to discover, from lightweight sunscreens and playful lip tints to complexion products suited to the country’s climate.
 Planning a trip? EVEANDBOY, one of the country’s best–known beauty retailers, has shelves packed with local brands, so knowing where to start can be tricky. Here are eight Thai beauty brands to know, whether you’re a skincare obsessive, a lip–tint collector or simply curious about local favourites.
 Ingu For skincare enthusiasts who like to know what goes into their formulas, Ingu puts ingredient transparency front and centre. Founded by Thai YouTuber Ing, who built a following by breaking down skincare ingredients and questioning marketing claims, the brand’s line–up includes the Brightening Crystal Serum for dullness, the Green Tea Retinol Serum Shot and the Brightening SkinLock Cooling Pad.
 Srichand Established in Bangkok in 1948, Srichand made its name with traditional face powders, and its Translucent Powder remains a signature. It sets makeup and helps control shine without adding much colour, making it especially useful in hot, humid weather. The brand has since expanded into moisturisers, serums and sunscreens.
 Her Hyness Sheet masks are among Her Hyness’ standout products, alongside its skincare and makeup offerings. The Instant Glow Black Mask Box features a serum containing royal jelly, pearl powder and arbutin, while the Instant Bright Black Mask is another pick for an at–home masking session. Toner pads and sunscreens round out the selection.
 Pañpuri Pañpuri brings fragrance, body care and aromatherapy–inspired products together under one roof. Alongside its fine fragrances and perfume oils, the brand offers face, body and hair care. The Ground Remembers fine fragrance and Luminous Dawn perfume oil are two options to consider for a fragrance souvenir.
 Mizumi Mizumi specialises in sun care, offering facial and body sunscreens, products for sensitive skin, masks, and lip care. The UV Jelly Aqua Fresh SPF 50+ PA++++ is designed to sit lightly under makeup, while the UV Aqua Lock Serum SPF 50+ PA++++ has a fast–absorbing, non–sticky texture.
 Cathy Doll Cathy Doll brings a playful streak to everyday makeup, with tinted sunscreens, lip oils, liquid blushes and eye shimmers. The Glow Oil Tint gives lips a glossy finish, while the Skin Fit Jelly Blusher adds a sheer wash of colour with its jelly–like texture. Both are easy picks for experimenting with fresh pops of colour.
 Dr. Pong Founded by a Thai doctor, Dr. Pong brings a clinical approach to skincare, with a line–up spanning serums, sunscreens, cushion foundations, and supplements. The 28D Whitening Drone Essence targets dullness and uneven–looking skin, while the BarrierX Ultimate Defense Serum focuses on supporting the skin barrier.
 Mistine Instagram content
 A familiar local name, Mistine offers affordable makeup and skincare across a wide range of categories. Its products are easy to find while shopping locally. For everyday makeup, the So Black Glossy Auto Pen Eyeliner defines the eyes, while the So Brow Auto Eyebrow Pencil helps keep brows looking groomed.
